description: Pooled dataset: 11 independent RMIT advanced-design runs. Ten (source_iteration 01-10) are separately-provisioned Azure Standard_D8s_v6 VMs across 4 VM instances / 3 regions (Central India x2, South India, West US 3), each with its own random seed. The eleventh (source_iteration 11) is the original single-VM validation run (experiments/azure_d8s_v6/run_00/, Central India, seed 271828182) that first caught the file-descriptor pitfall (paper §3), pooled in as an additional independent replicate of the same design. block_id offset by run_index*100 to keep paired-block comparisons scoped to the single VM run they came from.
